title: Apigenin Alleviates Pyroptosis in Lung Adenocarcinoma Cells by Modulating TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB Signaling and AIM2 Inflammasome Activation.
authors: Zhu, Kairui; Mu, Yulong; Su, Zhenguo; Yue, Zhen; Wu, Dongyang; Qu, Guiwu; Jiang, Chenyang; Li, Qing; Li, Youjie; Xie, Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芹菜素通过TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB和AIM2信号缓解肺腺癌细胞焦亡，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是细胞焦亡与药物机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pyroptosis-related signaling contributes to lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) progression and prognosis. Apigenin (AP) has anti-inflammatory and cytoprotective properties, but its effects on pyroptosis-associated signaling in injured LUAD cells remain unclear. METHODS: A549 cells were treated with carbonyl cyanide m-chlorophenyl hydrazone (CCCP) and ferrous sulfate (FeSO(4)) to establish a cellular injury model. Cell morphology, Cell Counting Kit-8 signals, and pyroptosis-associated proteins were assessed after AP treatment. Network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and analyses of The Cancer Genome Atlas and Gene Expression Omnibus datasets were used to prioritize candidate targets, characterize pyroptosis-related genes, and develop a prognostic signature. RESULTS: CCCP/FeSO(4) reduced CCK-8 signals and induced morphological injury, whereas AP partially reversed these changes. AP also reduced alterations in GSDMD-N, caspase-1, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB pathway proteins, AIM2, and ASC. TNF was prioritized as a candidate target, and computational analyses predicted a potentially stable AP-TNF interaction without demonstrating direct binding. Bioinformatic analyses identified distinct pyroptosis-related LUAD subgroups and generated a prognostic signature that stratified survival in training and external validation cohorts. AIM2 was additionally prioritized as a LUAD- and stress-associated candidate. CONCLUSION: AP attenuated CCCP/FeSO(4)-induced injury and pyroptosis-associated molecular changes in A549 cells, potentially through TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB and AIM2-related signaling. Further mechanistic validation is required.
abstract_zh: 背景：焦亡相关信号通路参与肺腺癌（LUAD）的进展和预后。芹菜素（AP）具有抗炎和细胞保护特性，但其对受损LUAD细胞中焦亡相关信号的影响尚不清楚。方法：使用羰基氰化物间氯苯腙（CCCP）和硫酸亚铁（FeSO(4)）处理A549细胞，建立细胞损伤模型。在AP处理后，评估细胞形态、Cell Counting Kit-8信号和焦亡相关蛋白。利用网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟以及癌症基因组图谱和基因表达综合数据库的分析，优先筛选候选靶点、表征焦亡相关基因，并开发预后特征。结果：CCCP/FeSO(4)降低了CCK-8信号并诱导形态损伤，而AP部分逆转了这些变化。AP还减少了GSDMD-N、caspase-1、IL-1beta、TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB通路蛋白、AIM2和ASC的改变。TNF被优先作为候选靶点，计算分析预测了AP-TNF之间可能稳定的相互作用，但未显示直接结合。生物信息学分析识别出不同的焦亡相关LUAD亚组，并生成了一个预后特征，该特征在训练和外部验证队列中对生存进行了分层。AIM2还被优先作为LUAD和应激相关的候选靶点。结论：AP减轻了CCCP/FeSO(4)诱导的A549细胞损伤和焦亡相关分子变化，可能通过TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB和AIM2相关信号通路实现。需要进一步的机制验证。
